How to use Power Thrive

Always follow the directions on your bottle. As a general guide:

  1. Read the label, including the supplement facts and warnings.
  2. Take the serving size shown on the bottle with water, usually with a meal.
  3. Take it at the same time each day to build a habit.
  4. Pair it with good sleep, balanced meals, hydration and regular movement.
  5. Give it time. Consistent daily use matters more than occasional use.

Who should talk to a professional first

Speak with your doctor or pharmacist before use if you are pregnant or nursing, take medication, have a medical condition, or are under 18. Keep out of reach of children. Stop use and seek advice if you have an adverse reaction.
